# --no-lattice re-emits the pre-R26 unrounded clamp. A corpus that does not
# go RED under it is not testing the lattice rule (k23_design.md 7.2.1).
#
# cases_random.tsv, 904 cells over 95 measured shapes:
#
# stride   cells DIFFER    shapes with >=1 DIFFER
# 1             0 of 506             0 of 57
# 2            51 of 290            29 of 29
# 3            30 of 108             9 of  9
# all          81 of 904            38 of 95
#
# The stride-1 zero is the point: at stride 1 the broken clamp and the
# correct one are arithmetically identical code, so no subject can separate
# them. That is why 855 cells of single-byte corpus were green against a
# real unsoundness -- structural blindness, not bad luck.
#
# Every stride>1 shape goes red, independently reproducing R26 E9's
# "12 stride>1 shapes, EVERY one wrong somewhere".
#
# Full per-cell output is not archived (it is 900 rows of a deliberately
# broken build); re-run with the command in the header to reproduce.
